tags: born in East Los Angeles, chose Mexico over the USA internationally after a widely covered eligibility decision
youngest signing in USL Championship history at 15 (LA Galaxy II, 2017)
career path: LA Galaxy II -> LA Galaxy (94 apps, 6 goals) -> Tijuana (52 apps, 8 goals) -> Chivas Guadalajara (2025-present, 46 apps, 3 goals)
Mexico U17 runner-up at 2019 U17 World Cup; senior Mexico debut 2021 (7 caps, 1 goal)
contract with Chivas expires 30 June 2026 - approaching free agency

mental_profile.notes: Publicly navigated a high-profile USA-vs-Mexico international eligibility decision as a teenager; no disciplinary record found.

public_statements: Widely reported US-vs-Mexico national team eligibility decision culminating in his choosing Mexico, debuting for the senior team in 2021.
off_pitch.notes: LA Galaxy was reported at one stage as 'not looking to sell' him (ABC7/ABC30, during his Galaxy tenure), indicating he was a valued asset there before his eventual transfer to Tijuana and then Chivas.
